Stalin Criticizes Tamil Nadu CM Over Hindi Signboard Row

DMK chief M.K. Stalin has criticized Tamil Nadu Chief Minister E.K. Palaniswami for remaining silent on the issue of Hindi signboards. The controversy touches upon the state's history of anti-Hindi agitations, which were significant in the 1960s.
